boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time on campus and in Rochester.

cards.title: See rotating work at Bevier Gallery
cards.subtitle: Booth Hall 2600, RIT campus
cards.notes: Stop in during weekday gallery hours to look through the current exhibition, then use the posted artist and show details to guide your conversation.
cards.short_summary: A free RIT campus gallery with rotating student, faculty, alumni, and visiting-artist work.
cards.evidence_claim: RIT states that Bevier Gallery is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Bevier Gallery | College of Art and Design | RIT
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Monday–Friday, 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed on weekends, RIT holidays/breaks, and during installations.

cards.title: Browse RIT City Art Space
cards.subtitle: 32 Adventure Place, downtown Rochester
cards.notes: Meet at the first-floor gallery and move through the exhibition together; check the gallery page before leaving because installations and breaks can close it.
cards.short_summary: RIT’s downtown exhibition venue presents art and design programming without an entry charge.
cards.evidence_claim: RIT says City Art Space exhibitions, events, and educational programming are free and open to the public year-round.
cards.source_title: About Us | City Art Space | RIT
cards.access_notes: The visit page lists summer hours Wednesday–Thursday 1–5 p.m., Friday–Saturday 1–8 p.m., and Sunday 1–5 p.m.; verify the current exhibition schedule.

cards.entity_name: RIT Nature Trails and Jogging Routes
cards.title: Walk the RIT Nature Trails
cards.subtitle: Wooded area by the Quarter Mile, south of the Student Life Center
cards.notes: Choose the measured 0.5- or 1.2-mile route and pause at The Bower; bring water and use the route PDF if you want a more deliberate walk.
cards.short_summary: Two measured woodland jogging routes on the RIT campus.
cards.evidence_claim: RIT describes 0.5-mile and 1.2-mile nature-trail routes adjacent to the Quarter Mile.
cards.source_title: Nature Trails and Jogging Routes | RIT Recreation and Wellness
cards.access_notes: Use the designated trails and check conditions before visiting; the page provides a downloadable trail and campus-jogging-routes PDF.

cards.title: Build a self-guided art-on-campus browse
cards.subtitle: RIT Libraries online exhibit
cards.notes: Pick an artist, artwork type, collection, or location from the archive, then compare a few entries and save a short list for a later campus walk.
cards.short_summary: A publicly accessible RIT Archives gallery of campus artworks.
cards.evidence_claim: RIT identifies Art on Campus as a publicly accessible gallery that can be browsed by artist, type, collection, and location.
cards.source_title: Online archive proves there’s plenty in a name | RIT
cards.access_notes: Available online; no campus entry or purchase is needed to browse the exhibit.

cards.title: Register for Film+FotoFest@RIT
cards.subtitle: MAGIC Spell Studios, September 16–17, 2026
cards.notes: Register when the form is posted, then make a plan to browse the trade-show floor, watch demos, and catch presentations with a friend.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled RIT photography and cinematography showcase with demos, exhibits, and talks.
cards.evidence_claim: RIT states that attendee registration for Film+FotoFest@RIT is free and open to the RIT community and public.
cards.source_title: Film+FotoFest@RIT | College of Art and Design | RIT
cards.access_notes: Scheduled for September 16–17, 2026; RIT says the registration form is forthcoming, so confirm details before attending.

cards.title: Explore Maplewood Nature Center
cards.subtitle: 107 Bridge View Drive, Rochester
cards.notes: Start with the interactive exhibits, then take the accessible trails through the gardens and use the birdwatching windows or riverway connection at your pace.
cards.short_summary: A city nature center with indoor exhibits, accessible trails, gardens, and a riverway-trail connection.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rochester lists free admission for Maplewood Nature Center.
cards.source_title: Maplewood Nature Center | City of Rochester, New York
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Friday 9 a.m.–4 p.m. and Saturday 9 a.m.–2 p.m.; the City also lists free parking and accessible trails.

cards.title: Look through the City Hall Link Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor, Rochester City Hall, 30 Church Street
cards.notes: Use the first-floor corridor between City Hall buildings as a short art stop, then take time to look closely at the current work by regional artists.
cards.short_summary: A Rochester City Hall gallery that displays work by artists and craftspeople from the region.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rochester states that admission to the Link Gallery is free.
cards.source_title: City Hall's Link Gallery | City of Rochester, New York
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed Saturday and Sunday.

cards.title: Play a casual tennis set at Genesee Valley Park
cards.subtitle: 131 Elmwood Avenue, Rochester
cards.notes: Bring racquets and balls, then claim an available court on a first-come basis for a low-key rally, set, or rotating doubles game.
cards.short_summary: Eight outdoor tennis courts in Genesee Valley Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rochester lists eight tennis courts at Genesee Valley Park and says its outdoor courts are free to use first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Tennis and pickleball courts | City of Rochester, New York
cards.access_notes: Courts are public and free on a first-come, first-served basis; a reservation is only needed to guarantee a selected court.

cards.title: Rally at Cobb's Hill Park
cards.subtitle: 80 Culver Road, Rochester
cards.notes: Pack basic tennis gear and use an open court for a rally or short set; coordinate a start time but expect first-come public use.
cards.short_summary: Six outdoor tennis courts at Cobb's Hill Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rochester lists six tennis courts at Cobb's Hill Park and says its outdoor courts are free to use first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Tennis and pickleball courts | City of Rochester, New York
cards.access_notes: Courts are public and free on a first-come, first-served basis; a reservation is only needed to guarantee a selected court.

cards.title: Set up a pickleball game at Maplewood Park
cards.subtitle: 89 Maplewood Drive, Rochester
cards.notes: Bring paddles and a ball, choose an open court, and keep the game flexible so others can join or rotate through the six courts.
cards.short_summary: Six city pickleball courts in Maplewood Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Rochester lists six pickleball courts at Maplewood Park and says its outdoor courts are free to use first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Tennis and pickleball courts | City of Rochester, New York
cards.access_notes: Courts are public and free on a first-come, first-served basis; a reservation is only needed to guarantee a selected court.
